text:
miriam: Action item from compliance review: tighten RBAC for onprem keystore-sync. Need it to only perform Rotate/Describe/Export-checks against customer keys. No Decrypt allowed. Also want a strategy to show auditors there was no direct KMS egress from app nodes. Thoughts?
aj: I’d build a KMS-proxy sidecar pattern. Proxy holds the KMS credential, enforces allowed operations per service identity, and mTLS for all inbound calls. App pods talk only to the proxy svc over cluster internal IP. Avoids placing KMS creds on workers.
sam_k: Network policy idea: deny-all egress at namespace level, then an explicit egress rule to keystore-proxy TCP/8443. Also force POD_SECURITY non-root + hostNetwork=false. Starter NP:```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-sync-egress-to-proxy
  namespace: keystore
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: sync
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: keystore-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443
```
And separate policy for proxy -> control-plane KMS IPs only.
sec-bot: SCAN ALERT: detected keystore-client 1.2.3 with export API flaw (CVE-2025-0100). Recommend upgrade to 1.2.5 or apply vendor patch. See https://sec.example/cve/CVE-2025-0100
olivia: Logging fields for SIEM correlation: timestamp, req_id, svc_account, operation, key_resource, outcome (ALLOW/DENY), local_pod, proxy_outbound_ip, vpc, tenant_id, trace_hash. Structured JSON preferred. Example:```json
{"ts":"2025-06-17T09:05:11Z","req_id":"req-22b1","svc_account":"svc/keystore-sync","operation":"Rotate","key_resource":"projects/prod/keys/alpha","outcome":"ALLOW","proxy_ip":"10.4.12.7","vpc":"vpc-prod-1","tenant":"tenant-789","trace_hash":"h1:abcd1234"}
```
miriam: Good. For audits we need tamper-evident proof that app pods never contacted external KMS endpoints directly. Can we capture that?
aj: Yes. Proxy should log TLS peer cert fingerprint and outbound IPs per request. Keep signed log anchors and publish attestation blobs to customer audit buckets. Optionally capture short pcaps on proxy egress interface with HMACed digest stored in audit area.
sam_k: Add eBPF-based conntrack telemetry on nodes as read-only for compliance. Provide a short, redacted export showing there were no connections from app pods to any non-proxy IPs during a period. That can be audited.
dinesh: Incident steps if something odd appears (export spikes/CVE exploitation): 1) apply KMS deny policy on affected key(s) immediately; 2) revoke keystore-sync SA tokens; 3) spin up emergency local ephemeral keystore for degraded operations; 4) rotate/rewrap keys; 5) collect forensic bundle (proxy logs, kube-audit, netpol traces); 6) notify customers per SLA. Keep commands simple and scriptable.
keystore-bot: NOTE: enqueued maintenance ticket due to CVE-2025-0100. Auto-created PR for client upgrade draft.
miriam: I want to rollout this RBAC change as a canary: proxy enabled but with Decrypt denied in 5% of clusters, observe logs for any ALLOW-Decrypt, and watch DENY rate. If anything spikes, auto rollback. How to implement?
aj: Use a label-based routing for proxy deployment (proxy.canary=true). Wire a small set of clusters (or nodepools) to use proxy.canary via Helm value. Instrument alerts: alert if any log with operation=="Decrypt" and outcome=="ALLOW" or if DENY rate > 5x baseline over 10 minutes. Also detect sudden increase in export operations.
sec-bot: POLICY REVIEW: proposed RBAC change previously included kms.keys.get at project-level. Recommend narrow to explicit key resource(s) with condition: request.auth.claims.service=="svc-keystore-sync" and request.time < timestamp(condition) for short-lived grants.
olivia: For privacy, include a trace_hash (HMAC of request id + stable secret) instead of full request payload so analysts can correlate without PII. Store HMAC key in keystore and rotate monthly.
sam_k: Pre-deploy checklist: - build & scan proxy image (SBOM + CVE scan) - lock down netpols - egress gateway validated & pinned IPs - observability: proxy access logs + eBPF conntrack - SIEM mappings complete - canary cluster list ready - runbook in vault
dinesh: Put an incident playbook stub in runbook vault. Example commands:```text
# revoke SA keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable --key-file=... || kubectl delete secret svc-keystore-token
# apply KMS deny policy (pseudo)
kmsctl deny --key projects/prod/keys/alpha --condition=all
# collect forensic artifacts
tar -czf forensic-$(date +%s).tgz /var/log/proxy/* /var/log/kube-audit.log /var/log/netpol-traces
```
miriam: OK I'll open a PR with: 1) precise RBAC binding (key-level), 2) proxy Helm chart and values for canary rollout, 3) SIEM field mapping and runbook snippet. Ping me for review. :thumbsup:
